# goslop text fixture — best-effort JS interop / stream probe with pass; reader stays None
lang: python
file: js_bridge.py
---
class RawIO:
    def __init__(self):
        self._reader = None
        self._response = None

    def _ensure_reader(self):
        if self._reader is None and self._response is not None:
            try:
                body = self._response.body
                if body is not None:
                    self._reader = body.getReader()
            except Exception:
                pass
